title_en: Khmer Handwritten Text Recognition with Tesseract
abstract: This fixture project builds a pipeline that segments Khmer handwriting into lines and characters and recognises them with Tesseract and a custom Khmer model. It reports character accuracy on a synthetic set of scanned forms and discusses common recognition errors.

title_en: Scanned Exam Sheet Digitization for Khmer Schools
abstract: This fixture project turns scanned paper exam sheets into searchable text. Pages are cleaned, deskewed, and read with optical character recognition so that teachers can search old exams by keyword.
This fixture project is a web application for booking study rooms in a campus library. Students reserve rooms online, librarians approve bookings, and a dashboard shows daily room usage.

title_khmer: ការចាត់ថ្នាក់ប្រធានបទព័ត៌មានខ្មែរ
abstract: This fixture project classifies Khmer news articles into topics such as sport, economy, and politics. Text is segmented into words with khmer-nltk and a linear classifier is trained on word features.
This fixture project reads soil moisture sensors on a small farm and shows the values on a web dashboard. Pumps are switched on automatically when the soil becomes too dry.
This fixture project records class attendance by recognising student faces in a classroom camera image. Its report file is intentionally blank so that the failed-parse path is tested.
This fixture project answers common course registration questions in a chat window. It is marked pending so it must never be indexed.
This fixture project forecasts monthly rice prices with an ARIMA model. Its only author is withdrawn, so the project must be skipped and never indexed.
